description: Changes the settings of an automation set up from Cosend’s “Review request” recipe, named by id, as its settings page in Cosend does: the settings given replace their values, the rest keep theirs, and the result is saved as a new version. If the automation is switched on, the new settings go live with the save, or the save is refused in words and it keeps running what it ran; if it is off, they wait for it to be switched on. An automation from another recipe, or one written by hand, is refused. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview with the settings as Cosend filled them in and its check of them, and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the new version.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The automation set up from the “Review request” recipe whose settings change.

settings.description: The settings to change, as the recipe’s settings form asks them. A setting left out keeps the value it has.

delay_hours.description: How long after the tag the request goes out.
delay_hours.title: Hours to wait

fallback_language.description: Sent when the customer’s own language isn’t one of the message’s approved languages. Left empty, the message’s first approved language.
fallback_language.title: Fallback language

not_again_days.description: A customer asked for a review in the last this many days is not asked again. The tag still comes off.
not_again_days.title: Not again within (days)

tag.description: Tag a customer with this when the job is done. The tag comes off once the request has gone.
tag.title: When a contact is tagged

template.description: A message approved by WhatsApp with your review link in it, as a button or in its text. Nothing is filled in.

owner_adds.description: The page where customers review you, like your Google review link. It starts with https://
owner_adds.title: Your review link

components.text: Thank you for choosing us for your recent job. We hope you are happy with the result. Would you take a minute to leave us a review?

template.title: Review request message
